description: Provision movement waterfall between two reporting dates.

cured_to_stage1.description:
Cured back to Stage 1 (net ECL release) — both Stage 2 → 1 and
Stage 3 → 1.

cured_to_stage2.description:
Partial cure Stage 3 → Stage 2 (net ECL change, typically a
release as Stage 3 lifetime ECL is de-recognised, partly offset
by Stage 2 lifetime ECL).

new_originations.description: New originations (new exposures added this period).

transfers_to_stage2.description: Transfers to Stage 2 (net ECL change from stage upgrades).

transfers_to_stage3.description: Transfers to Stage 3 (net ECL change from stage downgrades).

title: ProvisionWaterfall
